title: Annual Information Return of Income Taxes Withheld on Compensation

choice_rows.label: Item 8A — If private, top withholding agent?
Item 11 — Refunds of overwithholding/overremittance released to employees?
Item 13 — Month of first crediting of overremittance

validation.how: Red label works for model errors via has_error(key, error_key), but message text appears only in the bottom 'Needs review' box, capped at 20.

lists.label: Part II — Summary of Remittances per BIR Form No. 1601-C

findings.field: Item 13 — Month of first crediting of overremittance
findings.now: The first crediting month is shown as twelve small buttons (Jan–Dec) rather than one drop-down.
findings.why: The official form uses a select (frm1604c:select13, BIR-Form1604C.hta:694) and alerts 'Please select a month from the list on Item 13.' (BIR-Form1604C.hta:3066).

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Use a select with an empty first entry, as the official select13 does.

options.name: Dropdown beside Item 11A
options.detail: Put the month in a dropdown next to the Item 11A date parts, as the official txtRefMonth does.

findings.now: The year comes from the dashboard tile, yet the year box stays editable, and a different year saves the return as a separate draft.
findings.why: A draft is stored under its own year (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:141), so the typed year decides which row is written.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the period as a chip and change it only from the dashboard tile.

options.name: Combobox with warning
options.detail: Keep a picker, but warn before saving that another period opens a separate draft.

options.name: Lock after first save
options.detail: Allow changing the period only until a draft for that period has been saved.

findings.now: Item 11A is one text box that expects MM/DD/YYYY, and a wrong date is reported only in the bottom Needs review box.
findings.why: The official form splits Item 11A into a month drop-down and day and year boxes (BIR-Form1604C.hta:631; frm1604c:txtRefMonth, txtRefDate and txtRefYear in the layout), and the page has no such split.

options.name: Month select plus day and year boxes
options.detail: Mirror the official split so each part is checked as it is entered.

options.name: Date picker
options.detail: Use a calendar control that writes MM/DD/YYYY.

options.name: Text with an inline hint
options.detail: Keep the text box and show the format and the error beside it.

findings.now: The print preview shows only the first 71 characters of Item 7, although the saved return keeps up to 150.
findings.why: to_print_field_map() fills 40 and 31 slots (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1604c.rs:405), so later characters are dropped from the print only.

options.name: Limit Item 7 to 71 characters
options.detail: Add a validation message so the limit is seen before printing.

options.name: Shrink the text to fit
options.detail: Reduce the printed font so all 150 characters fit the two lines.

options.name: Separate page
options.detail: Print the overflow on an extra page and reference it on the sheet.

findings.now: Messages appear only in the bottom Needs review box, which stops at 20 entries, while Queue for submission is disabled at the top with no reason shown.
findings.why: The list is cut with take(20) (form_1604c_view.rs:1001), and the red label carries only the colour, not the message.

options.name: Message beside the field
options.detail: Show each message under its own field as well as in the panel.

options.name: Show all messages
options.detail: Render the full list in a scrollable panel instead of stopping at 20.

options.name: Reason beside Queue
options.detail: Show the first blocking message next to the disabled Queue button.

findings.now: The print preview shows the email in capital letters, although the stored email keeps the case typed.
findings.why: The print fill upper-cases writer-cell text joins and txtEmail is one (html-frozen/1604c-2018/writer-cells.json, p1c37), while the official capital() skips txtEmail (validation/package/js/string-util.js:241).

options.name: Skip the email in the upper-case step
options.detail: Exempt txtEmail in frozen_html.rs so print matches the stored value.

options.name: Named input on the sheet
options.detail: Give the frozen sheet a named txtEmail input so the join is not upper-cased.

options.name: Document the caps
options.detail: Keep the caps on paper and say on the preview that the email prints in capitals.
